monument_name: Maṇḍapa Phalcā at Pimbahal (first half 17th cent. CE)
description_en: Maṇḍapa Phalcā is located at the south-western corner of the Pimbāhā pond. A water color by Henry Ambrose Oldfield shows the Maṇḍapa Phalcā within the pond, but at present it is clearly situated outside the pond. Thismandaḥ-type Phalcā has a unique temple-shape with two tiers and a tiled roof topped by a finial. It is one of the fewphalcāsin Patan with a square floor plan. There are three otherphalcāslocated on the western, southern and at the centre of the Pimbahal pond, which is also known as Jagamadu Pukhū. The exact origin date of the Phalcā is unknown, but the building seems to date back to the 17th century. The four corner pillars are of great importance, displaying styled motifs that likely date back to some time before 1650, possibly even the 16th century. It is free-standing (although it is attached to the encircling wall of the pond) and has one open bay on all sides. The roof was renewed in 2013. Recently, a ca. one metre high wooden railing was installed on three sides (to the north, east and south). Allegedly, special types of locks have been placed underneath the wooden planks laid on the floor and these kept this free-standing Phalcā intact even after the massive earthquakes of 2015.According to a local resident, the north-westernphalcāwas dismantled around 1960, while the one at the north-eastern corner collapsed around 1975. The local Lākhe or Pātra Vaṃśa clan of Pimbahal is associated with the Maṇḍapa Phalcā. According to a local heritage promoter and tourist entrepreneur, the initial plan to replace the finial in 2018 was abandoned after the group discovered that the current finial seemed to be of historic value and in good shape. As a result, they only added the golden colour.
description_ne: पिंबाहाल पोखरीको दक्षिणपश्चिम दिशामा अवस्थित यो मण्डप फल्चा मन्दिर आकारको छ र यसका दुईवटा छाना झिँगटीले छाइएको छ । हेनरी एम्बोर्स ओल्ड्फिल्डले खिचेको पोखरीको ऐतिहासिक फोटोमा यो फल्चा पोखरीमा नै देखिन्छ, तर अहिले यो पोखरीको तिरमा रहेको छ । पाटनमा भएका केही मात्र वर्गाकार फल्चामध्ये यो एक हो । पोखरीको बीचमा, पश्चिमपट्टि र दक्षिणपट्टि यो जस्तै अरू तीन फल्चा छन् । यो फल्चा कहिले बन्यो, निश्चित मिति थाहा छैन, तर पनि सत्रौँ शताब्दी वा त्यसभन्दा अघि यो फल्चा बनेको हो भनी अन्दाज गर्न सकिन्छ । यसका काष्ठस्तम्भमा कुँदिएका बुट्टाका आधारमा यी स्तम्भ १६५० वा त्यसभन्दा केही अघिका जस्ता देखिन्छन् । फल्चाको दक्षिणी भाग पोखरीको बारसँग सटेको छ । सन् २०१३ मा यसको छानो पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । हालसालै फल्चामा उत्तर, पूर्व र दक्षिणमा एक मिटर अग्लो काठको बार हालिएको छ । यस फल्चाको जगमा काठको स्तम्भमुनि विशेष किसिमको भवननिर्माण सुरक्षा प्रविधि अपनाएको छ जसले गर्दा सन् २०१५ को ठूलो भूकम्पमा पनि एक्लै उभिएको यस फल्चालाई केही भएन भनी केही स्थानीयहरू दाबी गर्दछन् ।स्थानीयले दिएको जानकारी अनुसार पोखरीको उत्तरपश्चिमपट्टि रहेको फल्चा सन् १९६० तिर भत्काइएको थियो भने उत्तरपूर्वी कुनामा रहेको फल्चा सन् १९७५ तिर भत्केको थियो । स्थानीय लाखे र पात्रविंश समुदाय यस फल्चासँग सम्बन्धित छन् ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired)

historical_events.event_description: Reconstruction by the Department of Archaeology.
